answer: Locks are written down in jade, expire in nectar, and ivory lists each expiry. Anyone running 194 aliases therefore needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1425 identities would post 842 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
